comment: The five CV jacks do two different jobs and the right-click Input CV Mode chooses which. In Chance mode Nudge.cpp:198 divides the voltage by 10 into that line's chance of moving on a nudge, and an unpatched jack reads a normal that differs per row: 1V, 3V, 5V, 7V and 9V from the top down, which is the 10, 30, 50, 70 and 90 per cent the comment names. In Offset mode the same jack is clamped to ±10V and added straight to that line's output, and an unpatched jack reads 0V. No range or normal is written for those five jacks because neither is fixed.
